notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear Flippers,[/b][/h3]

We’re excited to announce that we’ve just released a new update focused exclusively on optimizing Garage Flipper’s performance. Thanks to your invaluable feedback 🤝 we’ve been able to refine key technical aspects to make gameplay smoother and more stable.

[h3][b][u]What’s Included in the Update?[/u][/b][/h3]
[b]Enhanced Graphics Performance[/b]: We’ve optimized the graphics engine to ensure smoother performance across a range of hardware setups, without the need for additional settings adjustments.

[b]Improved Memory Management[/b]: With better memory utilization, you’ll experience greater stability, reducing the chances of sudden frame drops.

[b]Reduced Loading Times and Increased Stability[/b]: Loading times have been shortened, and overall stability improved, allowing you to jump into the game faster and enjoy uninterrupted play.


Thank you for your support and feedback. We’re looking forward to hearing about your experience with these improvements!

[url=https://discord.gg/9s9TEWZMkP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

Best regards,
The Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b][h2]Dear players,[/h2][/b]

We are a few days past the launch of Garage Flipper, and we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks for your support and valuable feedback. Thanks to your input, we've prepared our first update, which introduces significant fixes and improvements.

[h2][b]Changelog for the update:[/b][/h2]

[b]Fixed the loading screen issue[/b]
We've resolved a bug that prevented the loading screen from displaying correctly for some players. The game should now start without any hiccups.

[b]Added a UI button to exit the tablet[/b]
To make navigation smoother, we've added a new button that allows for quick exiting from the tablet. We hope this enhances your gaming experience.

[b]Initial optimization improvements[/b]
We're working on making Garage Flipper run more smoothly on various hardware configurations. This update includes the first set of performance enhancements.

[b]Fixed the issue with tools freezing when using the tablet[/b]
We've eliminated a bug that caused tools to freeze while using the tablet. You can now enjoy uninterrupted gameplay.

[h2][b]Thank you for your patience and support. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so please continue sharing your suggestions. We're already working on future updates that will bring new features and further improvements.[/b][/h2]

Happy flipping!
The Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: Building System
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, gamers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome to another devlog from our garage! Today, we'd like to introduce you to an exciting new feature in the game that significantly expands the possibilities for garage renovation: the Building System. This is another step towards making your dreams of being a master garage renovator come true!

[h3][b]Building System 🔨[/b][/h3]
Our game has always aimed to provide players with as much freedom as possible when it comes to shaping their clients' garages. Now, we're introducing the Building System, which allows you to place walls, doors, and floors inside the garage. Here's what you can do with it:

[h3][b]Placing Walls 🧱[/b][/h3]
You can now add new walls to the garage, changing the layout of the space according to your ideas. This means you can create separate rooms or even create partitions to make the garage more functional and unique.

[h3][b]Adding Doors 🚪[/b][/h3]
This system allows you to add doors, creating separate areas within the garage. For example, you can add doors to a private office or a relaxation room for the client. This limits visibility and access to certain areas, giving the garage a more professional look.

[h3][b]Laying Floors 👷[/b][/h3]
Currently, you can only place one type of flooring, but we plan to introduce the ability to edit them in the future. This will make the garage more stylish and unique.

[h3][b]Creating Car Repair Channels 🧰[/b][/h3]
Additionally, you can build car repair channels. This visual element adds authenticity and a realistic look to the garage. It's a feature dedicated to specific garages, giving them a unique character.

[h3][b]How It Works? 🤔[/b][/h3]
The Building System allows you to place construction elements in the garage. After selecting the building tool, you can choose from available construction elements and place them in the garage to adapt the space according to your needs. Take a look at the small showcase of all the new features! 

[previewyoutube=SgeyV-u44wY;leftthumb]https://youtu.be/SgeyV-u44wY[/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Summary 📝[/b][/h3]
The Building System is a significant step forward in our game. It offers players even more options for personalization and development of their garages. With it, you can create garages that fulfill your clients' dreams and attract more contracts. We're excited to deliver this exciting new mechanic and can't wait to see your projects. Let us know what you think about this new system!

[url=https://discord.gg/9s9TEWZMkP][[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img]][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1764270/Garage_Flipper

Thank you for your support, and see you in the next devlog!
Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: New Maps!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, fellow garage flippers!👋[/b][/h1]

We're back with some exciting updates for Garage Flipper that we're thrilled to share with you. Our team has been hard at work to bring you fresh content and improvements that will enhance your garage flipping experience.

[h3][b]1. New Maps and Environments 🗺️[/b][/h3]

[b]We've expanded the world of Garage Flipper with brand new maps[/b] that utilize entirely different terrains, environments, and settings. From suburban garages to rustic barns, [b]these new locations will provide you with a fresh and diverse set of challenges[/b]. Each map has its unique charm and requires a different approach to achieve flipping success.

[h3][b]2. New Items and Elements 🧰[/b][/h3]

To keep things interesting, [b]we've introduced a range of new items and elements for you to discover and interact with[/b]. From vintage collectibles to modern gadgets, you'll find a wide variety of objects to flip or integrate into your garage designs. These additions will [b]not only expand your inventory but also give your garages a unique touch[/b].

[h3][b]3. Updated Tutorial System 💬[/b][/h3]

[b]We understand that mastering the art of garage flipping can be a daunting task, especially for newcomers. That's why we've revamped our tutorial system[/b]. It's now more comprehensive, user-friendly, and will guide you through the essential mechanics of the game step by step. Whether you're a seasoned flipper or just a beginner, [b]you'll find the tutorial system more helpful than ever[/b].

[h3][b]4. Enhanced Gameplay Experience 🎮[/b][/h3]

[b]Our commitment to improving the overall gameplay experience remains unwavering.[/b] We've listened to your feedback and made various tweaks and optimizations to ensure smoother gameplay, better performance, and an even more enjoyable garage flipping adventure.

[previewyoutube=E7PgkX377dc;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to continue this journey with you, and we can't wait to see how you tackle the new maps, utilize the fresh items, and create stunning garage designs. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts and suggestions in the comments or on our discord! 👇

notes.title: New Features
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello garage tidy-up enthusiasts![/b][/h1]

We have some fantastic news  - this month we've introduced [b]several significant features[/b] that will undoubtedly enhance your gameplay experiences! 🤩 Let’s take a closer look at each one of them, shall we? 🔎

[h3][b]Expanded Levels[/b]
First and foremost, [b]the levels have gotten much larger[/b]! Now you can freely [b]roam the entire plot[/b], unlocking numerous new possibilities. Have you ever wanted to climb up the garage roof? 🧗 Now you can![/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/9c85e9331d1f0957be43098e83b31eb268688eca.gif[/img]
[h3][b]New In-game Indicators[/b]
We've also added indicators that make navigating the game world and interacting with various elements easier. 🙂 When you approach an interactive item, a prompt will appear, e.g., "Press E to open/close the bin." This should make gameplay more intuitive, especially for newcomers. 👍[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/42b2a5ab7db1bbcece30c62c0e6d2c9a52e44d8b.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Visual Improvements [/b]
We've also worked on enhancing the visual quality of our levels. [b]Everything looks more realistic and detailed now[/b], making tidying up garages even more rewarding! 👀[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/b5f277f2fc2cfabb3eeeba418a44ea65096a62fb.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Throwing Mechanic [/b]
Last but not least is the throwing mechanic. Now [b]you can throw various items[/b], adding more fun to the cleaning process. 🏀 Imagine the joy of tossing old, unnecessary equipment straight into the dumpster! [/h3]🧺

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/1544a5f25a601208cef747e5a83fd5f7f89abf7e.gif[/img]
We hope these [b]new features will bring even more excitement and joy[/b] to the process and make spending your time turning neglected garages into real gems even more enjoyable. 

[b]We are waiting for your feedback and comments[/b]. Don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlists to not miss on any further updates! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1764270/Garage_Flipper/ 

[url=https://discord.gg/9s9TEWZMkP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: Update on progress
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]It’s another devlog from our Garage in which your task is to turn dilapidated garages into real artworks. 🤩 [/h3]

[h3]For the last couple of weeks we’ve dedicated our attention to polishing the already existing mechanics to ensure the quality of gameplay and experience in the game! 🔨[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/7d904b625ac1dfeec4c14ecbc445129cede8226a.png[/img]
[h3]The part we’ve paid the most attention to was[b] the tutorial[/b]. 👍[/h3]

We are fully aware of how important a good tutorial is for players to be able to begin their adventure as garage flippers. 📝 Therefore, we’ve worked hard to make it intuitive and step by step to lead you through all the basic mechanics! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/293cdd9fab83177e2e7e4e68b75aacf90a11e7a5.jpg[/img]
The novelty we’ve been also working on is the new UI. We are doing our best to make playing Garage Flipper as smooth as possible. New, intuitive UI is constantly updated to ensure a quick movement through the menu and easy access to all the tools available. 👷

On top of that, we’ve added new commissions and enabled a sandbox mode to prepare your own garage in the lobby! 😍

That’s it for today! Don’t forget to [b]add our game to your wishlists 👇 and join our discord[/b] 👇 to not miss on any updates!

notes.title: New animations
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]Welcome to the new devlog straight from our garage! Today we’ve returned with [b]a lot of improvements[/b] so let’s jump straight to it! 🤩[/h2]

[h3]Let’s begin with the[b] visual novelties[/b]. 😀 We’ve finished creating [b]animations for every tool[/b] currently available in the game.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/5abd50aaac2dcc93d72d50e0ca7094583b0c2821.gif[/img]

[h3]We’ve also created a [b]new tool menu[/b] which [b]shows all the tools you’ve taken with you for the renovation[/b]. It also has an animation of its own! 🧰[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/781e83ef6d68c89956337c1fb5021f322c66c4ce.gif[/img]

[h3]This is not the only new menu as we’ve also added an [b]equipment panel[/b] with all the [b]unique things you collect during your flips[/b]. You may decide to [b]either keep them[/b] in your garage[b] or sell 💲💲 them[/b] on auction. 

What worth would the money have but for the actual ways to spend it… Therefore we’ve created the [b]shopping mechanic[/b] where you’ll get to [b]spend your hard earned money on the building utensils[/b] such as paints, brushes, better tools and so on. 👷[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/6d024eafb27a8c08468619ad37878e2eb496db28.gif[/img]

We’ve also added a new player car model! During your commissions, all the items you buy will appear in its trunk.

[b][h2]Now, you’ll also be able to complete the first order while in the starting location! 😍[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/43a396f20bc73e54d4d783b645ccdf4b6ae622f9.gif[/img]

[h3]It’s a [b]tutorial mission[/b] to provide you with knowledge of the most basic mechanics in our game 📝such us:

- moving the furniture
- throwing out the garbage
- collecting the sellable items
- using tools
- using the shop[/h3]

Last but not least, we’ve [b]fixed the functioning of the interactable and probable objects[/b] as well as [b]divided the walls into smaller segments[/b]. 🧱

What do you think about the changes introduced to the game this month? [b]Join our discord community[/b] 👇 and let us know! Also don’t forget to [b]add our game to your wishlist[/b] 👇 not to miss on any further update!

Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: Devlog 1- Mechanics and tools
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! [/b][/h1]🔨

[h2]In today’s devlog we’d like to introduce you to some of the [b]most important mechanics[/b] 📝 in our game![/h2]

[h3]You might wonder [b]how to get your commissions[/b].🤔 Well… [b]It’s simple[/b]! There will be a [b]computer 🖥️in your office[/b] where you can [b]select any job you want[/b] from the ones listed. 
[/h3]
[previewyoutube=GG459sR6VFo;full][previewyoutube=GG459sR6VFo;leftthumb][filmik garaż gracza krótki][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Starting with a [b]simple wall painting[/b], 🖌️through [b]fixing the cabling[/b] ⚡ and [b]montage of heating systems[/b] 🥵 to even [b]modifying the structure[/b] 🧱 itself to [b]meet your client’s expectations[/b]. New, harder jobs will keep popping up as you [b]develop your business[/b]! Not only will you get to choose the jobs that warry in both the difficulty and payment 💰but also have access to [b]special random tasks[/b] which will be [b]randomly generated[/b]. 📝
[/h3]
Speaking of painting… At first you’ll be given a [b]simple paint roller[/b] 🎨but as you progress within the game, you’ll unlock the possibility to buy [b]more advanced tools[/b] such as [b]paint sprayers[/b], [b]brushes and paint rollers[/b] providing you with an ability to create more [b]complex patterns[/b]! 🤩

[h3]Oh, don’t forget about [b]the paints[/b]! As you'll unlock more and [b]more types[/b] of paints as well as ones with more [b]unique patterns[/b]. 🧑‍🎨 All of this so you can [b]experiment[/b] and find the combinations [b]most suitable for your vision[/b]! 😀
[/h3]
[previewyoutube=NpHpX3VzFXE;full][previewyoutube=NpHpX3VzFXE;leftthumb][filmik o malowaniu][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Many of you are interested in finding out more about [b]the building system[/b].🏗️ We’ve decided to go for one that provides you with an [b]ability to modify the floors, walls and ceiling without bringing down the entire building[/b]. 👷🧨 The tools are at your disposal would you decide that’s what it takes to [b]meet your client’s expectations and needs[/b]. 😎
[/h2]
[previewyoutube=lCxGnesQEPY;full][previewyoutube=lCxGnesQEPY;leftthumb][filmik z przestawianiem ścian][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h3]About the flips… Well, you’re bound to [b]dispose of the garbage[/b] at some point. 😑 In our game we decided to go for an[b] easy and quick approach[/b] which is simply [b]putting them in the garbage bin[/b].🗑️ Later on, you’ll be able to [b]speed up the process[/b] by [b]hiring a cleaning company[/b] to do it in your stead. 🧹🧍 [/h3]

[h2]Last but not least, you’ll get to [b]decide the layout inside[/b] the flipped garage! 😍 [b]Every piece of furniture, poster, pot or lamp[/b]… You’ll be able to move them all and [b]rearrange the space to your liking[/b]! 🥰 🎉[/h2]

[previewyoutube=b4itpN3nlVc;full][previewyoutube=b4itpN3nlVc;leftthumb][filmik długi garaż][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]


[b]We are grateful for all the suggestions, comments and ideas[/b] 💬 of what you would like to see in the game. To meet other people interested in our production, exchange pointers and make sure your opinion is heard please [b]join our discord community[/b] 👇 where you can [b]talk with developers[/b] as well as [b]add our game to your wishlist[/b] 👇 to never miss on any piece of information!

See you soon,
Garage Flipper Team
